subject: [GitHub] A personal access token (classic) has been added to your account
body:
Hey Erelthebot!

A personal access token (classic) "Evrnew Marketing System" with read:org and repo scopes was recently added to your account. Visit https://github.com/settings/tokens for more information.

To see this and other security events for your account, visit https://github.com/settings/security-log
